## Thermal anomaly patterns in Kapuas, Indonesia

This exercise examines **6,515 nominal- and high-confidence VIIRS S-NPP detections** in Kapuas Regency, Central Kalimantan, between **1 January and 31 August 2026**. It combines monthly descriptions, kernel density estimation and L-function comparisons to investigate spatial concentration and its implications for public-safety planning.

- [Read the technical report](technical-report.qmd) — data quality, reproducible R code, maps, statistical comparisons and interpretation.
- [View the executive summary](executive-summary.qmd) — eight slides of findings, limitations and planning implications.
- [Project repository](https://github.com/SHKnighter/ISSS608-VAA).

Satellite thermal detections are observations, not independent confirmed forest-fire incidents. The analysis distinguishes detection intensity from fire risk and identifies the additional evidence needed for management decisions.
